The diver is wearing a black wetsuit with yellow/green accents on the shoulders, a BCD, an air tank, and purple fins. Bubbles are rising from the regulator area towards the surface. The lighting is diffuse, typical of underwater environments, with some backscatter visible.

The regulator assembly is visible in the mouth area, connected to the hose system.

While the mask is present, the resolution and water distortion make it impossible to definitively verify 'visibility through the lens' (i.e., seeing the eyes clearly). Marked untestable to avoid hallucination.
